info.title: xping
info.description: Command-line companion for the Xping SDK. Reads the local run store written by Xping.Sdk.Core and reports test flakiness from recent local runs. No account required.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
xping - local test reliability reports

Runs are recorded by the Xping SDK. No account is required.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --cloud-url
options.description: Xping Cloud URL (default: https://app.xping.io)

options.name: --api-key
options.description: API key for reading Xping Cloud data; prefer XPING_APIKEY so the key does not land in shell history

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Write diagnostics to stderr [default: False]

commands.name: report
commands.description: Report test reliability findings from recent local runs

options.name: --runs
options.description: Recent runs to analyse (default: 20, or 14 days, whichever is fewer)

options.name: --since
options.description: Analyse from a commit SHA or a date (yyyy-MM-dd)

options.name: --top
options.description: Rows to show (default 10); findings about one test stay together, so a lower one can be shown ahead of a higher one about another test

options.name: --all
options.description: Show every finding rather than the top ones [default: False]

options.name: --kind
options.description: Restrict to one or more finding kinds

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text, json or summary [default: Text]

options.name: --json
options.description: Alias for --format json [default: False]

options.name: --summary
options.description: Alias for --format summary [default: False]

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Exit non-zero when a finding reaches this severity [default: None]

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Restrict to one test assembly

options.name: --id
options.description: Show one finding in detail, by the id on its row

options.name: --test
options.description: Show one test's run history, by its name or fingerprint

options.name: --directory
options.description: Resolve the store from this directory

options.name: --project
options.description: Read Cloud data from this Xping Cloud project key

options.name: --ascii
options.description: Force ASCII output [default: False]

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Never emit ANSI colour [default: False]

commands.name: where
commands.description: Show where local runs are stored

options.name: --directory
options.description: Resolve the store from this directory

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Only delete runs for one test assembly

options.name: --directory
options.description: Resolve the store from this directory

options.name: --force
options.description: Skip the confirmation prompt [default: False]

commands.name: login
commands.description: Sign in to Xping Cloud from your browser

options.name: --device
options.description: Sign in with a code on any device, for a browser on another machine [default: False]

options.name: --no-browser
options.description: Print the sign-in link without trying to open a browser [default: False]

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Preselect this workspace id on the consent page

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the result to stdout as JSON [default: False]

commands.name: logout
commands.description: Sign out of Xping Cloud and remove the stored sign-in

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the result to stdout as JSON [default: False]

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show which Xping Cloud credential is in use, without a network call

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the result to stdout as JSON [default: False]
